description: This file defines the ThemeManager class responsible for managing themes and color schemes within a web application, including theme activation, deactivation, caching, and responding to system color scheme changes.

classes.name: ThemeManager
classes.description: A class extending AbstractService that manages themes, including activation, deactivation, caching, and system color scheme responsiveness.

methods.name: onAppStart
methods.description: Initializes theme-related observers when the app starts.

methods.name: onAppEvent
methods.description: Handles various application events such as sign out, storage readiness, feature updates, launch, and preference changes.

methods.name: addAppEventObserverAfterSubclassesFinishConstructing
methods.description: Schedules adding the app event observer after subclass construction completes.

methods.name: addAppEventObserver
methods.description: Registers an event observer for application events.

methods.name: handleMobileColorSchemeChangeEvent
methods.description: Handles changes in mobile device color scheme preferences.

methods.name: handlePreferencesChangeEvent
methods.description: Responds to changes in user preferences related to system color schemes.

methods.name: webApplication
methods.description: Getter that returns the application cast as WebApplicationInterface.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Cleans up event listeners and internal state when the service is deinitialized.

methods.name: handleFeaturesUpdated
methods.description: Updates theme activation based on feature entitlement status.

methods.name: colorSchemeEventHandler
methods.description: Handles media query change events for color scheme.

methods.name: showColorSchemeToast
methods.description: Displays a toast notification prompting the user about applying system color scheme.

methods.name: setThemeAsPerColorScheme
methods.description: Sets the theme based on whether dark mode is preferred.

methods.name: activateCachedThemes
methods.description: Activates themes stored in cache.

methods.name: registerObservers
methods.description: Registers observers for desktop service updates and stream item changes.

methods.name: deactivateAllThemes
methods.description: Deactivates all currently active themes.

methods.name: activateTheme
methods.description: Activates a given theme, appending its stylesheet to the document.

methods.name: getBackgroundColor
methods.description: Retrieves the current background color from CSS variables.

methods.name: syncThemeColorMetadata
methods.description: Synchronizes the theme's background color with the meta theme-color tag.

methods.name: deactivateTheme
methods.description: Deactivates a theme by removing its stylesheet link.

methods.name: cacheThemeState
methods.description: Caches the current active themes to local storage.

methods.name: getCachedThemes
methods.description: Retrieves cached themes from local storage and reconstructs theme objects.
